Title: Register a new user and delete the account
Preconditions: User is not logged in; email not registered
Steps: 1. Open the home page | 2. Click Signup / Login | 3. Enter name 'QA Tester' and a unique email under New User Signup | 4. Click Signup | 5. Select title Mr | 6. Enter password | 7. Select date of birth 15 / June / 1990 | 8. Enter first name, last name, company | 9. Enter address, address2 | 10. Select country Canada | 11. Enter state, city, zipcode, mobile number | 12. Click Create Account | 13. Click Continue | 14. Click Delete Account
Expected Result: 'Account Created!' heading shown; header shows 'Logged in as QA Tester'; after deletion 'Account Deleted!' heading shown
Test Data: Name 'QA Tester'; password 'Passw0rd!123'; title Mr; DOB 15 June 1990; first 'QA'; last 'Tester'; company 'Test Co'; address '1 Test Street'; address2 'Suite 2'; country Canada; state Ontario; city Toronto; zip 'M5V 2T6'; mobile +14165550123; unique email per run

Title: Login with valid credentials
Preconditions: A registered account exists; user logged out
Steps: 1. Open /login | 2. Enter registered email and password | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is logged in; header shows 'Logged in as <name>'

Title: Login fails with an incorrect password

Expected Result: Error 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is shown; header still shows 'Signup / Login' and no 'Logged in as' text

Title: Login fails with an unregistered email
Steps: 1. Open /login | 2. Enter an unregistered email and password 'Passw0rd!123' | 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Error 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is shown

Title: Logout returns the user to the login page
Steps: 1. Click Logout in the header
Expected Result: Login page is shown (URL ends /login, heading 'Login to your account'); header shows 'Signup / Login'

Title: Signup fails with an already registered email
Steps: 1. Open /login | 2. Enter any name and the registered email under New User Signup | 3. Click Signup

Title: Login is blocked when email and password are empty
